correctness.rationale: For CP² with d_FS([u],[v])=arccos|<u,v>|, fixed-distance radial averaging has projective-harmonic multiplier phi_n=P_n^(1,0)(x)/(n+1), x=cos(2theta). First two phi1=(1+3x)/4 and phi2=(5x²+2x-1)/6: any sup<=1/8 requires -1/2<=x<=-1/6, where phi2+1/8=(5/6)(x+1/2)(x-1/10)<=0, with equality only x=-1/2. Recomputed exact Legendre values phi1..phi9 at x=-1/2; only n1,n2 reach -1/8. Jacobi-Legendre difference identity and uniform |Legendre P_n(x)|<=1 bound all n>=10 by 4/[3(n+1)]<1/8. Projective harmonic multiplicities (n+1)^3 give 8+27=35; selfadjoint spectral calculus gives ||T^k||=||T||^k. Infinite modes are controlled analytically, not by a finite sweep.
